correctness.rationale: Simultaneous commutation with the two structure maps forces the displayed four-parameter normal form. Direct expansion of both Rota–Baxter-system identities reduces pointwise to rs=0, tv=0, t(r-s-t)=0 and, away from a=1, v(r-s+v)=0. Elementary branching gives exactly six lines for a not equal to 1 and two planes plus two lines for a=1. Exhaustive checks over F2, F3, F5 and F7 match the formulas for every allowed a and every b.

value.rationale: The source uses this two-dimensional family as its principal concrete BiHom Rota–Baxter-system example. Completing its entire system locus reveals a genuine structural jump: six one-dimensional branches generically become two two-dimensional components plus two lines exactly when a=1. The jump is independent of b and has exact finite-field and zeta consequences, making the example substantially more informative than a single exhibited system.
